fr.elements: Main Residence; Vehicle Parking Area; Vehicle Parking Area; Vehicle Parking Area; Front Entry Area; Open Green Space; Walkway; Landscaped Area; Detached Structure
fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Dense Vegetation; Dense Vegetation; Limited Turnaround Space
fr.recommendations:
• Trim vegetation along the driveway and access paths to maintain clear sightlines and unobstructed movement between the main residence and detached structure.
• Cut back dense vegetation adjacent to access points so responders can quickly identify and reach all entry locations.
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from the road in both directions.
• Clear a designated turnaround area near the parking zone large enough for emergency vehicles to reverse and exit without backing blindly.
• Keep all parking areas clear of stored vehicles or equipment that would block emergency vehicle positioning or movement.
• Mark or post the location of the detached structure at the driveway entrance so arriving responders know a second structure exists on the property.
• Maintain the walkway between the front entry and parking area free of planters, furniture, or landscaping that would slow responder movement.
• Keep all gates at secondary access points unlocked or secured with a method compatible with emergency responder access.

wildfire.conditions: Large Trees; Scattered Trees; Tree Cluster; Scattered Trees; Vegetation Near Structure; Open Green Space; Multiple Access Routes; Adequate Vegetation Separation
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim branches on large trees that extend directly over or toward structures.
• Thin trees within the cluster nearest to the structures to create more open space between individual trees.
• Remove any shrubs or low-growing plants that are directly against the sides of structures.
• Separate scattered trees from nearby structures by clearing low branches up to at least 10 feet from the ground.
• Keep the area directly around each structure clear of dead leaves, twigs, and loose plant material.
• Maintain open ground between tree clusters and structures by removing any plants or debris filling those gaps.
• Keep both access routes clear of overhanging branches and encroaching vegetation along their edges.
• Mow or cut back low vegetation in the open green space where it approaches closest to structures.
